scope: Lifetime cleanup ownership and explicit staging close only; no product updater/IPC close route, native GUI or real HID run.
implementation: Publication, named archive sessions, group upload/export entries and media upload sessions register lifetime lease before creator job ends; deferred Drop work cannot begin after those owners have been drained.
Owned blocking cleanup plus monitor retains child lease; panic/I/O failures persist in bounded sticky admission health. wait_checked rejects even after active0.
Unique begin_maintenance capability seals atomically and is bound to original admission channel. Scope mismatch rejected before effects. Cancellation leaves seal; no reopen API.

Internal IpcServerImpl.close_staging seals upload registries, disposes font/media staging, cancels/removes archive/group registry references and cancels idle finite exports. Active workers retain owners through completion/disposal.

Media export remains strictly lazy: one blocking read per consumer demand, shared cancellable reader owner, no prefetch. Drop/final frame/error releases idle source pin immediately, descriptor retirement is enrolled cleanup. Blocking reads retain source/lease until actual exit.
Catalog/settings/assets and durable receipts preserved; only unpublished session state/resources invalidated.

checks.native_gui: not run; no frontend/native app source change

coverage: Cleanup after seal and dropped checked drain waiter, blocking cleanup ownership until release.
Sticky I/O/panic cleanup failure after zero count; unique/foreign maintenance scope checks.
Publication unknown Drop cleanup completes/retire, corrupt recovery report preserves manifest and blocks checked preflight.
Cancelled active import/export with removed registry entries; no false completion before blocking worker and final disposal finish.
Idle export cancellation without further consumer polling and detached blocked read ownership.
Real IPC private font/media/archive staging, anonymous descriptor closure, preserved baseline catalog, no HID or persistent settings reset.
Unchanged order/pin/final-frame and586frame late-corruption integration contracts.

intermediate_regression.state: Initial prefetch producer broke two existing media-export tests; run not counted as passing.
intermediate_regression.fix: Replaced prefetch with lazy shared reader owner; restored original assertions unchanged, idle pin release and late corruption detection; reran full workspace on unchanged final source.

remaining: Owned coordinator sequence: begin maintenance, close staging and quiesce/join keepers, then checked drain. Waiting first can retain registry/actor-owned publication refs.
Serialize manager target/HID ownership and any in-flight attach/replay; original handle transfer and joined teardown.
Bounded cancellation/shutdown/power policy, unresolved import/publication reconciliation and fresh serialized snapshot/asset pins.
Identity-bound probe, qualified journal/settings resolution including serial-less/missed reset recovery and EN/RU updater UI.
Admission is process-local; checked cleanup count does not prove actor/encoder/HID quiescence or hardware qualification.
